about: The register of package-modules.oracle.test.ts: how many of the packages installed under this repository's node_modules (nested ones among them, links to the workspace's own packages aside) the reader of package.json and Node's own resolver agree on, and how many disagree by each cause. A count that moves fails the test. Measured 2026-11-22, Node 26.13.1, 281 packages; before the reader followed Node's resolution of main, 229 agreed. Six nested copies were first registered as answered with the top-level copy's file; that was the oracle's question, not Node: without --experimental-import-meta-resolve, Node ignores import.meta.resolve's parent and resolves from the asking script. Asked with it, the six agree.

causes.a name of one of Node's own modules: Nod: punycode and string_decoder share their names with modules Node carries, and Node loads its own for the bare name; the reader names the package's own file, which is what the package's manifest says. Not a mend: within a workspace, the file is the package's entry.
